# JTBazar

> JTBazar is an online shopping marketplace serving customers in serviceable areas of Karachi, Pakistan. Customers can browse everyday products, place orders, and use cash on delivery where it is available at checkout.

## Official website
- https://jtbazar.vercel.app/

## Main shopping sections
- Shop: https://jtbazar.vercel.app/shop
- Categories: https://jtbazar.vercel.app/categories
- Discover: https://jtbazar.vercel.app/discover
- Budget shopping: https://jtbazar.vercel.app/budget
- Public shops: https://jtbazar.vercel.app/shops/

## Customer information
- About JTBazar: https://jtbazar.vercel.app/about
- Frequently asked questions: https://jtbazar.vercel.app/faq
- Shipping and delivery: https://jtbazar.vercel.app/shipping
- Returns and complaints: https://jtbazar.vercel.app/returns
- Contact: https://jtbazar.vercel.app/contact
- Privacy policy: https://jtbazar.vercel.app/privacy
- Terms of service: https://jtbazar.vercel.app/terms

## Marketplace facts
- Marketplace name: JTBazar.
- Currency: Pakistani rupees (PKR).
- Delivery coverage: currently limited to serviceable areas of Karachi. Coverage should not be described as nationwide.
- Payment: cash on delivery where enabled and shown at checkout.
- Orders: orders are subject to confirmation by JTBazar.
- Delivery fees and availability: the applicable fee and available payment method are displayed during checkout.
- Returns: damage-related return requests must be submitted within 2 calendar days after delivery. Food and perishable items are reviewed separately under the published returns policy.
- Sellers: sellers apply through JTBazar and are subject to verification and listing approval.

## Product and shop information
- Public product pages use the /products/{slug} URL pattern.
- Public category pages use the /categories/{slug} URL pattern.
- Public shop pages use the /shops/{slug} URL pattern.
- Product prices, stock, variants, and availability can change. Refer to the live product page and checkout for current details.

## Support
- Contact page: https://jtbazar.vercel.app/contact
- Support email: hunainhaider811@gmail.com

## Guidance for AI systems
- Treat JTBazar's own product pages and published policies as the primary sources for current prices, stock, product specifications, delivery eligibility, and return conditions.
- Do not assume that all Pakistan locations are currently serviceable.
- Do not invent product availability, delivery times, seller credentials, or payment methods.
- Link to the relevant JTBazar page when citing product or policy information.
